app.name: Filee
close.title: Keep Filee running?
close.text:
In the tray, the donut toolbar and watch folders keep working.
You can change this later in Settings → General.
home.title: Home
home.drop_hint: Or hold {0} while dragging files in Explorer. The donut toolbar opens at your cursor.
home.drop_hint_macos: Or hold {0} while dragging files in Finder. The donut toolbar opens at your cursor.
home.drop_hint_linux: Or hold {0} while dragging files in your file manager. The donut toolbar opens at your cursor.
home.accessibility_needed:
To open the donut by dragging with ⌥ Option, allow Filee under Accessibility.
It works as soon as you switch it on. If Filee is already listed and switched on, remove it with − and add it again with +: macOS doesn't carry the permission over to an updated or reinstalled Filee.
home.elevated:
Filee is running as administrator, so Explorer can't drop files on it or use its menu.
The shortcut can't read Explorer's selection either.
Restart Filee without administrator rights to fix this.
home.elevated_restart_failed:
Filee couldn't restart itself.
Quit Filee from the tray, then start it again.
elevation.notice_text:
Explorer can't drop files on Filee or use its menu while it runs this way.
Restart it without administrator rights.
startup.elevated_other:
Another Filee is running as administrator.
Explorer can't hand files to it.
Quit Filee from the tray, then start it again.
startup.no_answer:
Filee is running but didn't answer.
If it runs as administrator, quit it from the tray and start it again.
home.recent_empty: Your converted files will show up here.
home.no_matches: No recent conversion matches the search.
donut.group_empty: No presets left in this group. Edit it in Settings → Donut toolbar
error.empty_file: The file is empty (0 bytes). A file made with “New” in the right-click menu stays empty until you open it in its app and save it
format_request.notice_text:
Tell us which format you need.
Requests decide what Filee supports next.
Encrypted or copy-protected (DRM) files can't be converted, whatever the format.
error.no_route: No engine can do this conversion
error.cannot_turn: Rotate and flip work on images only
error.no_transparency: This format has no transparency, so there's nothing to trim
error.ocr_needs_tesseract: Apple Vision can't read this language. Install Tesseract in Settings → Engines
error.too_many_frames: Too many frames to save as pictures, raise "Every Nth frame"
error.too_many_pictures: Too many pictures for one video, split them into several
error.not_enough_space: Not enough free disk space for the pictures
error.no_motion_photo: This photo has no video Filee can read (an Android Motion Photo, or an iPhone Live Photo with its MOV next to it)
error.live_photo_start: The clip starts after the end of this video. Choose an earlier "Clip start"
error.live_photo_hdr: This FFmpeg has no zscale filter, so this HDR video can't become a Live / Motion Photo. Filee's FFmpeg download has it
error.rhwp_timeout: rhwp couldn't finish this long document in time
error.rhwp_timeout_calibre: rhwp couldn't finish this long document in time. For an e-book, move Calibre above the HWPX writer in Settings → Engines, and Calibre makes the PDF much faster
error.needs_shaping: This script needs LibreOffice to convert correctly. Install it in Settings → Engines
error.runtime_missing: A Microsoft Visual C++ runtime file this engine needs is missing or outdated. Update or reinstall Filee, or install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64)
error.pdf_no_tables: This PDF has no tables drawn with lines, so there is nothing to put in a spreadsheet. A scanned PDF has no text at all.
error.pdf_password_gone: The preset's PDF password isn't kept in the history, and the preset no longer has one. Convert the files again with a preset that has the password.
error.web_page: The link opens a web page, not a file. Filee can't download a file that needs you to sign in: save it from the browser first
error.web_too_large: The file is larger than 2 GB
error.web_blocked: Programs, installers and scripts aren't saved
error.geo_unknown_crs: The coordinates are not longitude and latitude, and the file doesn't name its coordinate system (next to a Shapefile, keep its .prj file)
error.geo_unsupported_crs: This coordinate system isn't supported yet
error.geo_bad_coordinates: The coordinates don't fit this coordinate system
error.geo_csv_no_coordinates: The CSV has no longitude/latitude columns and no WKT column
error.geo_csv_no_locations: No row of the CSV has a usable location
error.geo_unsupported_shape: This kind of shape isn't supported
error.geo_too_large: The Shapefile would pass the format's 2 GB limit
notice.pdf_not_smaller: Couldn't make it smaller, so it was copied as it is
notice.cad_newer_left_out: Objects the chosen AutoCAD version doesn't have (multileaders, meshes …) were left out
notice.original_kept: The original was kept, the result was saved as a copy
notice.original_in_trash: The original is in the Recycle Bin / Trash, the result kept its own name
notice.original_unchanged: Couldn't make it smaller, so the original was left as it is
trash.no_recycle_bin: this drive has no Recycle Bin / Trash
trash.in_use: the file is open in another program
trash.other_drive: the Trash is on another drive
trash.failed: it couldn't be moved to the Recycle Bin / Trash
trash.cannot_place: the result couldn't be saved in the original's folder
notice.ocr_has_text: Every page already has text, so it was copied as it is
notice.live_photo_pair: Saved as a photo and a MOV with the same name. Import both together (iCloud Photos, AirDrop or Photos on a Mac) to get a Live Photo
notice.geo_datum_assumed: The datum isn't WGS 84; positions were converted as if it were and can be off by up to hundreds of metres
notice.geo_gpx_lossy: GPX holds only points, routes and tracks with a few fields: other attributes were left out and polygons became tracks
notice.geo_text_cut: Some text was longer than a Shapefile field allows (254 bytes) and was cut
notice.geo_columns_dropped: A Shapefile holds 255 columns at most: the rest were left out
notice.geo_rows_without_location: Some rows have no usable location and were kept without a shape
notice.geo_field_names: Shapefile field names are 10 characters at most: some were shortened
notice.geo_shapefile_split: A Shapefile holds one kind of shape, so points, lines and polygons were saved as separate files
engine.reason.needs_package: Needs {0}. Install it in Settings → Engines
engine.magick.description:
JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, APNG, PSD, camera RAW and more.
Quality, size and DPI follow your preset.
engine.wic.description:
JPEG XR pictures (.jxr, .wdp, .hdp), such as HDR screenshots of Windows, to PNG, JPG and other images, with Windows' own codec.
HDR is tone-mapped so highlights keep their detail.
engine.pdfium.description: Renders PDF pages to PNG, JPG and TIFF (also multi-page TIFF and GIF) at the preset's resolution.
engine.pdfsharp.description:
Makes PDFs from images and merges, splits or cuts page ranges out of PDFs.
Also makes PDFs smaller by scaling down their pictures.
engine.rhwp.description:
Renders HWP/HWPX to PDF and converts HWP ↔ HWPX.
It also draws documents that reach PDF through HWPX (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, e-books…).
engine.unhwp.description: Extracts text, Markdown and HTML from HWP and HWPX.
engine.markdown.name: Markdown (built-in)
engine.markdown.description:
Markdown → HTML and plain text.
Text and script source files → UTF-8 TXT, without running scripts.
engine.spreadsheet.name: Spreadsheets (built-in)
engine.spreadsheet.description:
XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV into each other (XLS is read only).
One CSV per sheet.
engine.ooxml.name: Office Open XML (built-in)
engine.ooxml.description:
Macro-enabled files and templates (DOCM, XLSM, PPTM, DOTX…) ↔ DOCX, XLSX, PPTX.
Macros are removed.
engine.hwpx-writer.name: HWPX writer (built-in)
engine.hwpx-writer.description:
Writes HWPX from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, OFD, HTML, e-books and Markdown.
The first step of turning documents into PDF without Office.
engine.docx-writer.name: DOCX writer (built-in)
engine.docx-writer.description: Writes Word documents (DOCX) from PDF, OFD, HWP/HWPX, Markdown, HTML, spreadsheets, slides and e-books.
engine.pdf-text.name: PDF text (built-in)
engine.pdf-text.description: Extracts the text of PDFs in reading order, also from two-column pages (no OCR for scans).
engine.pdf-slides.name: PDF slides (built-in)
engine.pdf-slides.description: Turns PDFs into PowerPoint slides: each page becomes a picture on its own slide (looks like the PDF, not editable), with the page text in the speaker notes.
engine.pdf-tables.name: PDF tables (built-in)
engine.pdf-tables.description: Turns the tables drawn with lines in a PDF into an Excel workbook, one sheet each, with numbers and dates as real values.
engine.email.name: E-mail (built-in)
engine.email.description:
E-mails (EML, Outlook MSG) to HTML and text with sender, recipients and date, pictures included; attachments into a ZIP.
MSG to EML. Saved web pages (MHTML) to one HTML file with their pictures.
engine.data.name: Data (built-in)
engine.data.description:
JSON, JSON Lines, YAML, TOML, XML and CSV into each other.
vCard contacts and iCalendar events to CSV and back.
Comments are dropped. CSV holds tables only.
engine.vector.name: Vector graphics (built-in)
engine.vector.description: SVG and SVGZ to vector PDF, images and DXF; pictures traced into SVG; Illustrator files saved with PDF content.
engine.icns.name: ICNS (built-in)
engine.icns.description: macOS app icons (ICNS) from and to images.
engine.font.name: Fonts (built-in)
engine.font.description: Fonts: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT into each other.
engine.cad.name: CAD (built-in)
engine.cad.description: AutoCAD drawings: DWG ↔ DXF, and both to PDF, SVG and PNG.
engine.model3d.name: 3D models (built-in)
engine.model3d.description: 3D models: GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, 3MF and PLY into each other, FBX into any of them, and a PNG preview.
engine.geo.name: Geospatial vector data (built-in)
engine.geo.description:
Geospatial vector data: GeoJSON, KML, KMZ, GPX, Shapefile and CSV (longitude/latitude or WKT) into each other.
Results are WGS 84 longitude/latitude; projected Shapefiles (UTM, Web Mercator, Lambert, Albers) are converted.
engine.archive.name: Archives (7-Zip)
engine.archive.description: Extracts ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO and more, and packs ZIP, 7Z or TAR.GZ (7-Zip).
engine.ebook.name: E-books (built-in)
engine.ebook.description:
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics (CBZ, CBR) to PDF, EPUB, DOCX and text.
Also documents to EPUB, EPUB to KEPUB for Kobo and PDF to CBZ.
engine.subtitle.name: Subtitles (built-in)
engine.subtitle.description:
Subtitles: SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, SAMI (SMI), LRC, TTML, MicroDVD and SCC into each other, saved as UTF-8.
Korean SMI and SRT files in CP949 / EUC-KR read correctly.
engine.ffmpeg.description:
Video and audio: MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and more.
Also extracts sound and subtitles, makes GIF and APNG animations and saves images as HEIC.
engine.pandoc.description:
Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown
reStructuredText, LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, MediaWiki, DocBook, Jupyter and more ↔ Markdown, HTML, DOCX and ODT
Markdown and Org → PPTX slides
engine.ghostscript.description: EPS, PostScript and older Illustrator files to PDF and images; PDF to EPS and PS.
engine.tesseract.description: Recognizes the text of scans and pictures (OCR): searchable PDF, DOCX, TXT.
engine.vision.description: Recognizes the text of scans and pictures with macOS's own text recognition (OCR): searchable PDF, DOCX, TXT. Nothing to download.
engine.calibre.description:
Rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, CHM, PDB, RB…) and Kindle output (MOBI, AZW3).
Above the HWPX writer, it also makes the PDFs of e-books (much faster for long books).
engine.libreoffice.description:
Reads older and less common formats: DOC, PPT, Pages, Keynote, Numbers, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks, Publisher, Visio…
Also saves as DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT, ODP, OpenDocument templates and EMF.
crop.hint_keys: Arrow keys move the frame, Shift × 10 · Esc closes
clip.length_hint: A clip of this many seconds from the start
clip.fast_hint: Copies the video as it is: done in a moment and nothing is lost, but the clip begins at the key frame before the start (up to a few seconds early). Turn off to cut exactly at the chosen frames (encodes again, takes longer).
clip.hint_keys: Space plays · C cuts · Del cuts out (a gap), Shift+Del closes up · drag across pieces or Ctrl / Shift+click to select several, Ctrl+A all · drag a piece's edge to trim it · ← → by 0.1 s, Shift by 1 s · S / E / P start, end or playhead · Ctrl+Z undoes · Z zooms · Enter saves · Esc closes
clip.fast_needs_encode: Cuts, speed, volume or fades: the clip is encoded again, so it can't be copied as it is.
clip.cut_hint: Cut the piece in two at the playhead (C)
clip.delete_hint: Cut the selected piece out, leaving a gap with a button to close it (Delete); Shift+Delete closes up at once. On A1 it mutes the piece's sound, on A2 it removes the music
clip.magnet_hint: Magnet (M): the playhead, the piece edges and the music snap to cuts and to the playhead
clip.zoom_hint: Zoom the timeline in on the clip, or out to the whole video (Z)
clip.mute_hint: Mute the selected piece's sound; its picture plays on (Delete on A1 does it too)
clip.music_hint: Put music from a file under the clip (A2): drag it along, drag its line for the volume
clip.no_music: This file has no sound to use as music
clip.speed_hint: Speed of the selected piece; the sound keeps its pitch
clip.remove_silence_hint: Find the silent stretches of the clip and cut them out (Ctrl+Z puts them back)
clip.close_gaps_hint: Close every gap left by pieces cut out
clip.fade_in_hint: Fade in from black and silence over 1 second
clip.fade_out_hint: Fade out to black and silence over 1 second
clip.cannot_cut: Put the playhead inside the clip, not right at a cut
clip.last_piece: The last piece that plays can't be cut out
merge.order_hint: Select a file and move it up or down. Files are merged from top to bottom. (Alt+↑ / Alt+↓)
pdf_editor.title: Edit PDF pages
pdf_editor.hint: Reorder, rotate or delete pages. Add pages from another PDF, or extract the selected page as its own file.

general.title: General
general.start_with_system: Start Filee when I sign in
general.show_menu_bar_icon: Show Filee in the menu bar
general.dock_failed: Could not change Filee's Dock icon.
general.context_menu: Show “Convert with Filee” in the Explorer context menu
general.context_menu_macos: Show “Convert with Filee” when you right-click files in Finder
general.context_menu_linux: Add “Convert with Filee” to the file manager
general.integration_macos:
Finder shows it in the right-click menu (under Quick Actions or Services when the menu is long).
Keep Filee in Applications.
general.integration_linux:
Adds file actions to Thunar, Nautilus, Nemo and Dolphin.
To change Thunar's shortcut, close Thunar first and reopen it afterwards.
general.startup_entry_missing: The sign-in entry was removed or changed right after it was saved. Security software may be blocking it.
general.modern_menu_hint:
On Windows 11 this entry is under “Show more options”.
It can also go in the main menu (Windows asks for administrator permission once).
general.modern_menu_on: “Convert with Filee” is in the main Windows 11 menu.
general.modern_menu_outdated:
The main-menu entry belongs to an older or moved copy of Filee.
Add it again to update it.
general.modern_menu_cancelled: Cancelled. The entry stays under “Show more options”.
general.modern_menu_failed: Windows did not add the entry: {0}
general.modern_menu_remove_failed: Windows did not remove the entry: {0}
general.default_output_hint:
Presets set to “Default save location” save here.
A preset with its own location keeps it.
general.keep_dates: Keep the original file dates for every conversion
general.keep_dates_hint:
Converted files keep the original's created and modified dates, with every preset.
Off: only presets with "Keep the original file dates" do it.
general.browser_drops_hint:
Hold the key and drag a picture, a link to a file or a download out of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari: the donut toolbar opens as it does for your own files. The file is saved in this folder, and presets that save next to the original put the converted file here too.
Filee downloads a link itself, without your browser's sign-in.
general.browser_drops_only_converted_hin: The original waits in a temporary folder and is deleted once it's converted.
general.zip_geo: Save every geospatial result as a ZIP
general.zip_geo_hint:
Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML, GPX and the other geospatial results are packed into one ZIP per file, with every preset.
Off: only presets with "Save the result as a ZIP" do it.
general.close.Tray: Keep Filee running in the tray
general.no_history: Don't keep a history of recent conversions
general.history_limit: Conversions to keep in the history
update.notice_text: Press Update and Filee downloads and installs the new version. Your settings are kept.
update.notice_text_portable:
This is the portable version.
Download the new zip and unpack it over this folder. Your settings are kept.
update.installing: The installer is running. Filee starts again when it is done.
update.failed: Couldn't update automatically. Download the new version from filee.sh.
update.failed_alert:
Couldn't download the update.
Press OK to open filee.sh and download the new version there.
update.rolled_back_alert:
Couldn't install the update, so Filee kept the version you had.
Press OK to open filee.sh and download the new version there.
update.cancelled: Update cancelled. Press Update again to install it.
update.level_hint.Required: Fixes problems that affect your files. Please update.
update.level_hint.Optional: New features. Update whenever you like.

triggers.title: Shortcuts
triggers.description: Choose how the donut toolbar opens. You can add as many gestures as you like.
triggers.macos_permissions:
Allow Filee in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
If Filee is already switched on but gestures don't start, remove it with − and add it again with +.
Finder also asks for Automation permission the first time you use a selection shortcut.
triggers.linux_x11:
Drag gestures work on X11.
With file manager integration on, the first keyboard shortcut runs Thunar's Filee action (reopen Thunar after changing it).
Hold gestures and shortcuts in other file managers aren't available. Use the Filee menu or the drop zone.
triggers.linux_gnome_wayland:
GNOME Wayland: enable “Filee donut at the cursor” in the Extensions app, then hold Ctrl and drag a file in Files.
After first installing or updating the extension, sign out and sign in again if it has not loaded. No administrator access or input group is needed.
Drag gestures, custom modifiers, Pause and excluded apps are supported. Global selection shortcuts, hold gestures, Tab and wheel flipping during a drag are not provided by this integration.
triggers.gnome_waiting:
Waiting for the Filee GNOME extension.
Enable “Filee donut at the cursor” in Extensions. After installation or update, sign out and sign in if needed. The drop zone and file manager actions remain available.
triggers.gnome_version_mismatch:
The Filee GNOME extension that's running belongs to another version of Filee.
Sign out and sign in again so GNOME loads the installed extension. If this stays, reinstall Filee.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.linux_wayland:
Gestures that follow the cursor aren't available on Wayland.
Use an X11 session, or convert with the file manager menu and the drop zone.
Thunar can use the first keyboard shortcut after it restarts.
triggers.linux_wayland_experimental:
Gestures on Wayland are experimental and work on KDE Plasma and Hyprland.
Filee reads the mouse from /dev/input. On KDE Plasma a KWin script places the donut at the cursor; on Hyprland a window rule in hyprland.conf does (see INSTALL.txt). Ctrl+drag in other apps can be interrupted; use another modifier such as Ctrl+Shift if it gets in the way.
triggers.hook_stopped:
Global input detection is stopped.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.hook_linux_backend:
Gestures couldn't start because the X11 input libraries didn't load.
Use an X11 session and install libxtst6 and libxt6 (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libxtst6 libxt6), then retry.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.flip_description: While the donut is open, this key or a turn of the mouse wheel shows its back. Each donut gets its back under Donut toolbar.
triggers.flip_key_taken: {0} can't flip the donut: the donut or a shortcut already uses it.
triggers.flip_key_unknown: This key can't be used. Try another one.
triggers.excluded_hint: Type an app name and press Enter, e.g. photoshop
triggers.excluded_none_running: No other app has a window open.
triggers.excluded_note: Gestures and shortcuts do nothing while the pointer is over these apps.
toolbar.title: Donut toolbar
toolbar.reset_profile_confirm: Reset “{0}” to its default presets and extensions? Your other profiles and presets stay as they are.
toolbar.name: Name
toolbar.hint_add: Drag a chip onto the donut to add it
toolbar.hint_remove: Drag a slice back here to remove it
toolbar.hint_reorder: Drag slices onto each other to reorder
toolbar.hint_edit: Right-click a slice or use ✎ to edit
toolbar.max_reached: A donut holds up to {0} presets
toolbar.face_hint_off: Choose a key or the mouse wheel in Shortcuts to flip the open donut
group.hint: A group is one donut slice for several presets: rest on it or move outward and they fan out around it.
group.empty: No presets yet. Add some below.
group.full: A group holds up to {0} presets.
group.delete_confirm: Delete the group “{0}”? Its presets stay.
toolbar.ext_none: No extensions yet. This profile is only used once you add some.
toolbar.ext_invalid: “{0}” isn't a file extension (e.g. jpg or tar.gz).
toolbar.ext_claimed_first: {0}: also in “{1}”, which comes first in the list, so these files still open “{1}”.
toolbar.ext_claimed_later:
{0}: also in “{1}”.
This profile comes first in the list, so these files now open this one instead.
toolbar.ext_unknown:
{0}: Filee doesn't know this file type.
You can keep it, but these files can't be converted.
toolbar.mixed_toggle: Use for mixed selections (files of different types)
toolbar.mixed_locked: Filee needs at least one profile for mixed selections, so this one stays.
toolbar.mixed_title: Show this toolbar when every selected file is one of:
toolbar.mixed_catch_all: Nothing checked: used for any mix of files that no other profile takes.
toolbar.mixed_shadowed:
Nothing is checked, so “{0}”, earlier in the list, takes every mix.
Check some extensions to use this profile.
toolbar.mixed_covered: “{0}” comes first and allows every extension checked here, so this profile is never used.
toolbar.mixed_others_self: No mixed profile is left with nothing checked, so this one is also used for every other mix.
presets.title: Presets
presets.name: Name
presets.cad_version_hint: Older versions open in older AutoCAD and CAD programs. Before 2007, text is saved in the code page that fits it (Korean, Chinese, Japanese …) and any other character as a \U+ code. Objects the version doesn't have, such as multileaders and meshes, are left out. A 2007 DWG is saved as 2004, which AutoCAD 2007 opens.
presets.keep_color_profile_hint:
Available when metadata is removed.
Without it, wide-gamut photos (Display P3 from phones) can look washed out.
presets.remove_background_hint:
Makes a plain background transparent: the paper behind a signature or stamp, the backdrop of a logo.
The colour along the edge counts as background, so leave some paper around the artwork.
JPG has no transparency and gets the colour below. Not for photos of people.
presets.background_tolerance_hint:
Higher removes more, like shaded paper or smudges. Too high thins light strokes.
To keep a light fill inside an outline, turn on "Keep enclosed areas".
presets.keep_enclosed_background_hint:
Removes only the background touching the edge, so the white inside a logo stays.
Leave off for handwriting (it would keep the paper inside letters like "o").
presets.multipage_tiff: Put every file into one multi-page TIFF
presets.multipage_tiff_hint:
Each image and each PDF or TIFF page becomes a page, in order.
One PDF is enough for a multi-page TIFF.
presets.fits_tiff.Linear: Linear: the data as it is
presets.fits_tiff_hint: For pictures from a telescope camera. The TIFF keeps the file's bit depth: 8 and 16 bits stay as they are, 32-bit and floating-point data become 32-bit floating point.
presets.fits_debayer: Debayer FITS from a colour camera
presets.fits_debayer_hint: FITS pictures are stretched automatically. A raw frame from a colour camera becomes colour with the Bayer pattern in its header; off keeps it mono.
presets.animation_speed_hint:
Shows each frame of an animation for a shorter or longer time.
Players show at most 50 frames a second, so a faster animation leaves frames out.
presets.save_every_frame: Save every frame of a video
presets.save_every_frame_hint:
A video becomes a folder with a picture of each frame instead of one still frame.
A long video gives many files.
presets.frame_estimate: One minute of 30 fps video gives {0} pictures, at most {1} per video.
presets.extract_motion_photo_hint:
A photo becomes the video saved with it: the one inside an Android Motion Photo, or the MOV next to an iPhone Live Photo.
Other pictures become a video of the still picture.
presets.crossfade_hint: Each picture fades into the next over a second instead of cutting to it.
presets.live_photo_hint.apple: A short clip becomes a photo and a MOV with the same name and a shared Live Photo identifier. Import both into Photos together. The video is at most 1440 px on its shorter side. Experimental: not yet confirmed on every iPhone.
presets.live_photo_hint.android: A short clip becomes one JPG (NAME.MP.jpg) with the video inside, as Pixel phones save Motion Photos, for Google Photos and other galleries that read them. The video is at most 1440 px on its shorter side. Experimental: not yet confirmed on every phone.
presets.merge: Merge all files into one PDF
presets.pdf_tables_note: From a PDF, each table drawn with lines becomes its own sheet (a table that goes on over the next page stays one sheet), with numbers and dates as real values. Text outside the tables is left out.
presets.pdf_compression_hint:
Pictures are scaled down and saved as JPEG.
Text, fonts and drawings stay as they are.
If the result isn't smaller, the original is kept.
presets.pdf_ghostscript_hint:
Often smaller, but it rewrites the whole file.
The smallest result is kept.
presets.ocr_hint:
Scans and pictures get text you can search and edit. Needs Tesseract (Settings → Engines).
Pages that already have text stay as they are.
presets.ocr_hint_macos:
Scans and pictures get text you can search and edit, with macOS's own text recognition (Apple Vision). Languages it can't read need Tesseract (Settings → Engines).
Pages that already have text stay as they are.
presets.pdf_password_hint: Empty for none. It is saved with the preset, so use one only for this kind of file. PDF/A can't have a password, so it's off while PDF/A is ticked.
presets.combine_pages_hint:
Puts all pages one under another in a single image.
Very long results are scaled to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
presets.combine_pages: Stack the pages into one tall image (when a PDF is converted)
presets.trim_page_margins: Cut the blank space above and below each page
presets.split_tall_image: Too tall for the format: split into several images
presets.split_tall_image_hint:
Off: a long image is scaled down to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
On: it keeps its size and is split between pages into several files (name_1, name_2, …).
presets.leave_out_pictures_hint:
Off: the pictures are saved in a "name_files" folder next to the Markdown file and linked from it.
On: only the text, no folder.
presets.media_quality_hint:
When the new format can hold the codecs as they are (iPhone MOV → MP4), the video is only rewrapped.
No quality lost, HDR kept, done in seconds.
Small always re-encodes to make the file smaller.
presets.video_codec_hint:
H.264 plays everywhere.
HEVC files are about half the size and play on most phones, TVs and recent PCs.
AV1 is smaller still but slow to encode and needs a recent device.
A video already in the chosen codec is only rewrapped.
presets.hardware_encoding_hint:
Encodes H.264, HEVC and AV1 on the graphics chip.
Much faster and uses less power.
Slightly lower quality at the same file size.
Without a usable chip (AV1 needs a recent one), the video is encoded as usual.
presets.combine: Put all files into one archive
presets.extract_note: Each archive is extracted into a folder of its own. Where it goes is set under Output.
presets.trace_note: Used when a picture (PNG, JPG, …) is traced into vector shapes.
presets.trace_detail_hint:
Low smooths the outlines and drops specks.
High follows the pixels closely and keeps small details.
presets.subfolder_only_several: Only when a file becomes several
presets.subfolder_only_several_hint: A file converted to one file is saved next to the original; only one that becomes several files (a PDF split into pages) gets the subfolder.
presets.keep_dates_hint: Converted files get the created and modified dates of the original, so photos still sort by date.
presets.zip_result: Save the result as a ZIP
presets.zip_result_hint: The files of the result (a Shapefile's .shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj and .cpg) are packed into one ZIP next to the source, in place of loose files.
presets.replace_original_hint: The result takes the original's name and place, and the original goes to the Recycle Bin / Trash. Only when the result has the same format, never for watch folders or files from a browser. When the original can't go there, it stays and the result is saved as a copy. The result is saved in the original's folder, whatever "Save to" says.
presets.delete_confirm: Delete “{0}”? It will also be removed from every toolbar and group.
presets.select: Select a preset to edit it
theme.title: Theme
theme.style.soft_hint: Classic Filee look with soft rounded corners and pastel surfaces.
theme.style.material_you_hint: Google Material 3 design with dynamic tonal surfaces and adaptive accent roles.
theme.reduce_motion_hint: Recommended for older PCs. Turns off transitions and the donut's bounce.
theme.window_size_hint: Makes everything in Filee's windows larger or smaller. In any window, {0} + mouse wheel and {0} + plus / minus do the same, and {0} + 0 goes back to 100%.
theme.preview_toggle: Sample switch (preview only, not a setting)
theme.preview_toggle_hint: Shows how switches look in this theme. It doesn't change any setting.
engines.title: Conversion engines
engines.description:
Filee picks the best available engine for each conversion.
When several can do the same job, the higher one wins.
engines.optional_description:
Large engines are only downloaded when you want them.
They are kept when Filee updates and removed when you uninstall it.
engines.update_notice_title: Engines you installed have a new version
engines.all_description: Drag a card (or use its arrows) to change the order.
engines.lo_description:
LibreOffice can take over conversions it does more faithfully.
Without LibreOffice these switches change nothing.
engines.lo_slides_hint:
Slide backgrounds and shape positions come out as in PowerPoint.
Off: the built-in route, which can lose backgrounds or move shapes.
engines.lo_documents: Use LibreOffice for Word documents → PDF
engines.lo_documents_hint:
Laid out as in Word, including Chinese and Japanese punctuation rules.
Off: the built-in route.
engines.lo_sheets_hint:
Printed like Excel, with the print area, page setup and page breaks.
Off: the built-in route fits each sheet to the page width (page breaks kept).
engines.lo_hwp_hint:
Off by default: rhwp usually looks more like 한글.
Turn it on to compare when rhwp gets a document wrong (overlapping text, misplaced tables).
engines.package.libreoffice.name: LibreOffice (older and rare formats)
engines.package.libreoffice.description:
Needed for old or uncommon formats: DOC·PPT, OpenDocument presentations, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks·MacWrite, Apple Pages·Numbers·Keynote, Publisher·Visio and more.
Also saves as DOC·XLS·PPT·ODT·ODP·EMF and makes presentations → PDF more faithful.
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and HWP convert without it.
engines.package.pandoc.name: Pandoc (Markdown, LaTeX, Org and more)
engines.package.pandoc.description:
Adds Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown, and LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, Jupyter and other markup.
Also makes PPTX slides from Markdown.
Markdown and HTML → PDF, DOCX and HWPX work without it.
engines.package.ghostscript.name: Ghostscript (EPS and PostScript)
engines.package.ghostscript.description:
EPS, PS and older Illustrator files → PDF and images, PDF or SVG → EPS/PS.
SVG and PDF-compatible AI files convert without it.
engines.package.tesseract.name: Tesseract (text recognition, OCR)
engines.package.tesseract.description:
Reads the text of scanned PDFs and pictures: searchable PDF, DOCX, TXT.
Each language downloads the first time it is used.
engines.package.ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg (video and audio)
engines.package.ffmpeg.description:
Adds video and audio conversion, video → GIF or still image, sound from videos and GIF → MP4.
Only needed for video and audio.
engines.package.calibre.name: Calibre (Kindle and rare e-book formats)
engines.package.calibre.description:
Saves MOBI and AZW3 for Kindle and converts rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, PDB, CHM…).
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics are read without it.
engines.package.system_required: Use a copy installed on this computer.
engines.guidance.macos: Install {0} for this Mac, then choose “Use my copy…” and select its program or .app folder.
engines.guidance.macos.ffmpeg:
Install it with Homebrew (brew install ffmpeg), then choose “Check again”.
Or choose “Use my copy…” and select its bin folder.
engines.guidance.macos.ghostscript:
Install it with Homebrew (brew install ghostscript), then choose “Check again”.
Or choose “Use my copy…” and select its bin folder.
engines.guidance.macos.tesseract:
Install it with Homebrew (brew install tesseract), then choose “Check again”.
Or choose “Use my copy…” and select its bin folder.
engines.guidance.macos.calibre: The calibre Filee downloads needs macOS 14 or later. Install calibre 7.26, the last version for this macOS, from calibre-ebook.com, then choose “Use my copy…” and select its .app folder.
engines.guidance.linux: Install {0} with your distribution’s package manager, then choose “Use my copy…” and select its program folder.
engines.guidance.linux.libreoffice:
Install it with your package manager (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libreoffice), then choose “Check again”.
Opening HWP also needs Java and the H2Orestart extension.
engines.guidance.linux.ghostscript: Install it with your package manager (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install ghostscript), then choose “Check again”.
engines.guidance.linux.tesseract: Install it with your package manager (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install tesseract-ocr), then choose “Check again”.
engines.guidance.windows:
Filee has no download of {0} for this PC.
Choose “Use my copy…” and select an installed copy.
engines.remove_confirm: Remove {0}? You can download it again later.
engines.update_recommended:
Update recommended: this copy is {0}, Filee is tested with {1}.
Most conversions still work.
engines.use_own_hint: Already have it? Pick its program and Filee uses that instead of downloading its own.
engines.use_own_missing: That folder doesn't have everything Filee needs: {0}.
engines.remove_failed: The engine is in use. Try again after the running conversions have finished.
about.title: About
about.license: Filee is free software under the MIT license.
about.support_text:
Filee is free and open source.
A star on GitHub, a bug report, an idea or a sponsorship all help.
sponsor.title: Sponsor Filee
sponsor.lead: Filee is free and stays free. If you'd like to support its development, pick whichever way suits you.
sponsor.note.github: Monthly or one-time, by card through GitHub
sponsor.note.kofi: A one-time coffee, no account needed
sponsor.star: A ⭐ on GitHub costs nothing and helps other people find Filee.
feedback.notice_text:
A star on GitHub helps other people find Filee.
Problems and ideas are welcome too.
setup.title: Choose conversion engines
setup.description:
Images, PDF, Office documents, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts, CAD and 3D models already convert.
Download engines only for video and audio or rare formats.
setup.note: You can install or remove engines at any time in Settings → Engines.
installer.title: Filee Setup
installer.welcome.fresh: Setup installs Filee {0} on this computer.
installer.welcome.update:
Filee {0} is installed.
Setup updates it to {1}; your settings, presets and engines stay as they are.
installer.welcome.license: Filee is free and open source (MIT license).
installer.options.title: Options
installer.options.space: Filee needs about {0} of disk space.
installer.options.later: You can change these later in Filee under Settings → General.
installer.options.update_note: Filee keeps its other settings. Change them any time in Filee under Settings → General.
installer.task.modern_menu: Also show it at the top of the Windows 11 menu, not only under “Show more options”
installer.task.cli: Add the “filee” command to PATH (convert from the command line)
installer.engines.when: Filee downloads the engines you pick from their official sources when it starts.
installer.status.removing_old: Removing the previous version (settings and engines are kept)…
installer.status.explorer_menu: Adding Filee to the File Explorer menu…
installer.done.title: Filee is ready
installer.done.text:
Filee runs in the notification area of the taskbar.

To convert files, drag them while holding the trigger key, or right-click them in File Explorer.
installer.done.updated: Filee is updated. Your settings, presets and engines are as they were.
installer.done.engines: The conversion engines you picked download when Filee starts.
installer.warning.runtime:
{0} can't run: it needs the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime ({1}), which this computer doesn't have. Everything else in Filee works. To fix it, install Microsoft's Visual C++ Redistributable (x64):
{2}
installer.error.title: Filee was not installed
installer.error.space: There isn't enough free space on {0}: Filee needs {1}, but only {2} is free.
installer.error.damaged: This setup file is damaged. Download it again from filee.sh.
installer.error.windows: Filee needs 64-bit Windows 10 version 1809 or later.
installer.error.rolled_back: Setup put everything back: the previous Filee still works.
installer.error.nothing_changed: Nothing on this computer was changed.
installer.uninstall.title: Uninstall Filee
installer.uninstall.text: This removes Filee {0} from this computer, with its File Explorer menu entries, its startup entry and the conversion engines it downloaded.
installer.uninstall.delete_settings: Also delete my settings, presets and toolbars
installer.uninstall.settings_where: They are in {0}. Keep them to have them back when you install Filee again.
installer.uninstall.done: Filee is no longer on this computer.
installer.uninstall.settings_kept: Your settings stay, for when you install Filee again.
watch.title: Watch folders
watch.description:
Files that land in these folders are converted while Filee runs.
Downloads and copies wait until they're complete.
watch.originals_keep: Leave the original where it is
watch.originals_hint: Moving originals makes the folder work like an inbox, and files already waiting there when Filee starts are converted too.
watch.include_placeholder: Type an extension or a name, then Enter (e.g. heic, scan_*)
watch.include_hint:
Leave empty to convert every file.
· heic → files ending in .heic
· scan → files with "scan" in the name
· * stands for any text, ? for one character (e.g. scan_*.jpg)
watch.name: Base name
watch.name_hint: The buttons add parts of the name. Leave it empty to use the preset's name.
watch.token.name: Original name
watch.rename_intro:
Set the base name, then change parts of it with rules if needed.
The preview shows the name each file will get.
watch.rename_no_steps: No changes. Pick one on the left or add one if you need it.
watch.rename_try_placeholder: Type a file name, e.g. IMG_0412.jpg
watch.include_matches: {0} file(s) in the folder match now
watch.recipes_hint: Double-click one (or press +) to add it as a rule, then change it if you like.
watch.preview_keep: The original stays where it is
watch.cli_hint: Also on the command line: filee watch <folder> --to <format>
sheet_studio.title: Spreadsheet Print Studio
sheet_studio.invalid_range: Enter a valid range, for example A1:S52.
sheet_studio.warning_scale: The workbook requests only {0}% scale. This often makes the table tiny.
sheet_studio.warning_wide: Very wide content has no print area. Use Content, then choose how many pages wide it should be.
whats_new.title: What's new in Filee {0}
whats_new.2_0_0.browser.title: Drop straight from your browser
whats_new.2_0_0.browser.text: Hold the shortcut and drag a picture or a file link out of a web page. The donut opens, saves it and converts it.
whats_new.2_0_0.flip.title: The donut has a back face
whats_new.2_0_0.flip.text: Press Tab or turn the mouse wheel while the donut is open to flip it over to more presets.
whats_new.2_0_0.formats.title: More formats
whats_new.2_0_0.formats.text: Web archives (MHTML), OFD e-invoices, Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML and GPX maps, JPEG XR, FBX models and POTM templates.
whats_new.2_0_0.crop.title: Crop before you convert
whats_new.2_0_0.crop.text: Drop pictures on the Crop slice. Press A over a picture to pick a ratio right there, then Crop & Next.
whats_new.2_0_0.theme.title: Softer, and in your colours
whats_new.2_0_0.theme.text: Pick any accent colour, round things off with Softness, and make the donut see-through.
whats_new.2_0_0.languages.title: Filee speaks more languages
whats_new.2_0_0.languages.text: Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, Russian, Arabic and Brazilian Portuguese join English, Korean, Chinese and Polish.
whats_new.2_0_0.more.title: And a little more
whats_new.2_0_0.more.text: Reset a single donut to its defaults, search your whole history, and convert Gujarati, Hindi or Arabic documents through LibreOffice.
